lines.beaver_en: Team leader, you have someone to recommend?
lines.en: Yes, I recommend Kim Seojun from the sales team.
lines.roman: Ne, yeongeoptim Gim Seojun ssireul chucheonhamnida.

lines.en: He's a jack of all trades, strong in thinking and creativity.
He's decisive and bold, but not reckless.

lines.beaver_en: He's young. Isn't he easily distracted?
lines.learner: 말이 많다 뿐이지 일할 때는 집중합니다.
lines.en: It's only that he talks a lot; he focuses at work.
lines.roman: Mari manta ppuniji ilhal ttaeneun jipjunghamnida.

lines.beaver_en: How are his attitude and will?
lines.en: He has a strong sense of responsibility and perseverance.

lines.beaver_en: How was he when he failed?
lines.en: Even if he fails, he has the mental strength not to give up.

lines.beaver_en: Does he show off his achievements?
lines.learner: 으스대지 않고 절제할 줄 아는 사람입니다.
lines.en: He doesn't swagger; he knows restraint.
lines.roman: Euseudaeji anko jeoljehal jul aneun saramimnida.

lines.en: He's very cooperative and devoted to the team.

lines.beaver_en: Will he adapt well to a new department?
lines.learner: 새 환경에도 잘 적응하고 잠재력이 큽니다.
lines.en: He adapts well to new environments and has great potential.
lines.roman: Sae hwangyeongedo jal jeogeunghago jamjaeryeogi keumnida.

lines.beaver_en: I see. I think we can make him a leader.
lines.en: Thank you. You can trust my judgment.
